approaches.title: Merge each adjacent pair and take the minimum
approaches.summary: For each pair of numbers, compute the concatenation by shifting the first number by the number of decimal digits in the second, then return the smallest merged value.

revisions.shortChangeSummary: Counts the second number’s digits by repeated division, computes each pair’s merged value, and takes the minimum.
